flows.name: Create the next manual billing period
steps: Enter From, To, and Due Date
Reload the canonical route and read back the database
flows.expectedOutcome: The new period is Open, the previous period is Closed, and all dates persist

flows.name: Edit and reopen a billing period
steps: Set the selected period to Open
flows.expectedOutcome: The edited values persist and exactly one project period is Open

flows.name: Reject invalid or duplicate periods
flows.expectedOutcome: The UI presents actionable errors and no invalid row is persisted

flows.name: Configure automatic periods
flows.expectedOutcome: Automatic configuration persists through the canonical server owner with documented semantics

checks: No nested cards or page-level wrapper border

claims.description: The starting open-period state is captured
The completed manual or automatic setup is captured before submit
The new open period and automatically closed previous period are captured
Dates, status, configuration, and the one-open invariant are verified in the database
Reload and edit values are verified
Invalid and duplicate date-range behavior is verified
Desktop and tablet visual review is complete
Durable API/domain regression tests cover the invariants
